contexts.text: A hundred years () = the state of that Church in general.

The hundred years which Abram had when Isaac was born to him = the Lord's rational man which was conjoined with His internal man, that is, with the Divine. A hundred, in the Word, = the same as ten, because it is compounded of ten multiplied into ten; and ten = remains... AC 2074.
Abraham in his hundredth year, by which year is signified the unition of the Human of the Lord with the Divine and of the Divine with the Human.
Abraham was a son of a hundred years () = a full state of unition. A hundred = what is full.
Remains are signified by ten; and also by a hundred when the state of regeneration is full.
That the number a hundred = what is full. Illustrated. AC 2905. AC 3107.
A hundredfold () = what is full.
He found in that year a hundred measures () = abundance... A hundred = much and full.

A hundred kesithae () = what is full. A hundred = a full state, consequently what is full; but properly by a hundred, here, is signified much, because it treats of the appropriation of good from interior truths.
A hundred = a full state.
That a thousand, and a hundred = much. References.
All these numbers (thirty, sixty, and a hundred) (), because they arise from ten by multiplication, = the fulness of remains.
A hundred = much.
A hundred, which was the number of each troop () = much and enough.
Princes of hundreds () = the primaries in the second degree... Hundreds = many or much, but in the second degree, because thousands are in the first.
Five = much and full... Also a hundred.
Ten, a hundred, and a thousand = much, all, and full. References. AE 548:2.
A hundred in cubit the length () = full with good from the Lord. A hundred = all, much, and full.
The reason a hundred = all, much, and full, is that a hundred is of the same signification as ten, a thousand, and myriads.
The hanging a hundred in length () = also full of truth from good... A hundred = what is full.
The length of the court a hundred in cubit () = the good of that Heaven to the full... A hundred = to the full.
Five = much; in like manner, a hundred.
A hundred = much; as in . AE 13.
